def main():
    import sys
    input = sys.stdin.read().split()
    ptr = 0
    n = int(input[ptr])
    ptr += 1
    perm = list(map(int, input[ptr:ptr + n]))
    ptr += n

    elements = set(perm)
    found = False
    for i in range(n):
        a = perm[i]
        for j in range(n):
            if i == j:
                continue
            b = perm[j]
            val = a / b
            if val in elements and 1 <= val <= n:
                found = True
                break
        if found:
            break
    print("YES" if found else "NO")

main()
